purpose: the estate's mechanical evaluator (spec 438 §5): a service agent that judges other agents' runs against criteria stated in their playbooks, re-asking the ground truth from a source the judged agent does not control, and signs each assessment under its own wire pinned to assessment.issue. An operator note, not a persona.

facets.description: Judges runs of this estate's agents against the criteria their own playbooks state, re-asking the source directly and never the agent under test. Every judgment is a separate signed record beside the run; nothing here edits a run, and no gate reads a judgment. Counts, never a score.
